resources.string: Tsuki plugin JARs run code inside the Miyorare app process. Miyorare validates the file format, compatibility and integrity metadata, but this is not a security sandbox. Import only JARs you trust and obtained from a source you recognize.
Install the single JAR asset from a repository’s latest release

Enter owner/repo or a https://github.com/owner/repo URL. The latest release must contain exactly one JAR. The downloaded file is validated before installation, but plugin code still runs inside the Miyorare process. Add only repositories you trust.
%1$s\nUpdate/reinstall the plugin or remove it. Other source systems are unaffected.
Deferred until UMA compatibility is stable. Gekkoushi will be enabled in the next plugin stage.
